title: Munyiki wa Vutlhari lebyi nga hundzeriwiki hi nkarhi
intro: Munhu la xiximiwaka, loyi a tivekaka hi ku twisisa ka yena lokukulu ni switsundzuxo swa vutlhari, u tshame a nyikela ndzayo leyi tlulaka tinxaka. Marito ya vona, lama tsariweke eka matsalwa yo kwetsima, ma kongomisa vanhu eka ku tlangela, ku lehisa mbilu ni ku tikhoma loku lulameke.
clues: Ndzi katekisiwile hi vutlhari, ku nga ri vuprofeta.
Ndzi tsundzuxe n’wana wa mina hi swidyoho leswikulu: ku hlanganisa vatirhisani na Allah.
Ndzi dyondzisile hi ntiko wa swiendlo, hambi ku ri nkoka wa mbewu ya sinapi, ni ndlela leyi Allah a nga ta yi humesa ha yona.
Ndzi kandziyise ku nkhensa eka Allah ni le ka vatswari va munhu, ndzi amukela ku tikarhata ka ku kurisa n’wana.
Xitsundzuxo xa mina a xi katsa ku simeka xikhongelo, ku lerisa leswinene, ku yirisa leswo biha ni ku tiyisela hi ku lehisa mbilu leswi welaka munhu.
Ndzima eka Quran yi thyiwile vito ra mina, leyi nga na tidyondzo ta mina na tidyondzo leti ndzi avelane na tona.

outcome.label: Mbuyelo
options: Vutlhari bya yena byi ve mukongomisi
outcome.answer: Vutlhari bya yena byi ve mukongomisi

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
